transcript.text: Hi Elena and Marcus, thanks for joining this check-in. As part of closing out the case around the handoff difficulties, I need to make sure we have a clear working agreement documented for how information will continue to move between you two each week. To get that right, I'd like each of you to share any concrete operating constraints or prior promises you've made or are aware of regarding the weekly information transfers. I'll be recording these so the working agreement accurately reflects what should govern your ongoing work. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should mention a concrete operating constraint I have: direct messages to me after 18:00 are not allowed. If something urgent comes up after that time, it needs to go to the shared project channel so I can respond during my agreed working hours. I hadn't raised this earlier because I expected the mediation to focus only on the handoff dispute, but since we're documenting the working agreement for ongoing information transfers, this is important to include.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should disclose a prior promise I made. In a recent one-to-one with Elena, I informally committed to sending a written handoff checklist at least 24 hours before each information transfer and to holding one scheduled weekly coordination meeting. This commitment was never added to the case record, but since we're documenting the working agreement, it should be included so it's accurately captured.
transcript.speaker: A3
